campaign.html_content:
Meet the local crew behind Chaparral. Junk hauling and handyman work, one honest call.
 

Hello From Your New Neighbors

Someone Who Actually Shows Up

That is what makes a cleanup feel easy. We are Chaparral, a family owned crew right here in the Inland Empire, and this first note is just a hello.
 

We started Chaparral to give the Inland Empire a dependable local option: a crew that shows up, quotes honestly, and leaves your space cleaner than we found it.

We handle junk removal and small home repairs in one visit, so you can make one call and get the whole list moving.

Got a pile to clear or a repair that keeps waiting? Start with a free, no-pressure estimate.

Get a Free On-Site Estimate

Or just reply to this email and we'll take it from there.

Dependable junk removal and handyman services for Murrieta, Temecula, Menifee, Wildomar, Corona and the surrounding Inland Empire.

emails.title: 03. Chaparral Junk 2026 08 Newsletter What To Expect
emails.html_content:
No mystery, no surprises. Here is exactly what a junk removal day looks like.
 

How It Works

Simpler Than You Might Think

If you have never hired a crew to haul stuff away, the not knowing part can stop you. So here is the whole thing, start to finish. No mystery.
 
1

You Call or Reply

Tell us what you have and we will find a time that works.
 
2

We Look and Quote

We look in person and quote the job before we touch a thing.
 
3

We Haul and Clean Up

Our crew handles the lifting and hauling, then sweeps the space clean.

Start with a free estimate. We give you the price, and you decide from there.

Get a Free Estimate

Or just reply to this email and we'll take it from there.
